# Kind support per target and channel

> **Back to:** [README](../../README.md) · [Documentation index](../index.md)

Which artifact kinds each target delivers on each channel. `scaffold` = files written into a
project by `sigil add` (and the target's `sigil build` layout); `plugin` = marketplace plugins
built by `sigil build`. `native` = emitted as its own file or config fragment; `via inline` =
carried inside the skills that `uses:` it; `—` = not delivered (see the numbered note). Why the
channels are split this way: [distribution-channels-2026-09](../decisions/distribution-channels-2026-09.md).

## scaffold

| Kind | claude | copilot | agents-standard | codex |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mcp | native | native | — (1) | — (2) |
| hook | native | native | — (3) | native |
| settings | native | — (4) | — (5) | — (6) |
| prompt | native | native | — (7) | — (8) |
| skill | native | native | native | native |
| agent | native | native | — (9) | — (10) |
| rule | native | native | via inline (11) | via inline (12) |
| workflow | native | native | — (13) | — (14) |
| template | — (15) | — (15) | — (15) | — (15) |

1. the open standard (Agent Skills, AGENTS.md) defines no MCP config file shared by its tools; install it for a tool-specific target
2. not built yet: needs a TOML writer
3. the open standard (Agent Skills, AGENTS.md) defines no hooks; install it for a tool-specific target
4. this kind's schema is Claude Code's own vocabulary — sigil has no Copilot emitter for it
5. the open standard (Agent Skills, AGENTS.md) defines no settings; install it for a tool-specific target
6. this kind's schema is Claude Code's own vocabulary
7. the open standard (Agent Skills, AGENTS.md) defines no user-invoked prompts with arguments; install it for a tool-specific target
8. Codex custom prompts are deprecated in favor of skills — [OpenAI Codex — Custom prompts](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/custom-prompts)
9. the open standard (Agent Skills, AGENTS.md) defines no subagents; install it for a tool-specific target
10. a Codex agent file can't restrict tools, so a catalog agent would gain every tool — [OpenAI Codex — Subagents](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents)
11. folded into each skill that `uses:` it — [Agent Skills — the open standard](https://agentskills.io)
12. folded into each skill that `uses:` it — [OpenAI Codex — Build skills](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills)
13. the open standard (Agent Skills, AGENTS.md) defines no workflows; install it for a tool-specific target
14. Codex has no workflow file
15. templates are composed into other artifacts at resolve time, never emitted
